## What changed

Describe the user-visible outcome and why it is needed.

## Verification

List the exact commands and results. Note any provider calls, local limits, and
data sent. Use fictional fixtures.

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests cover the changed behavior or the verification explains why a test is unnecessary.
- [ ] Local search still works without a provider key.
- [ ] Source Markdown is unchanged unless the proposal explicitly introduces and reviews a source-writing path.
- [ ] No private notes, credentials, state databases, or private provider output are included.
- [ ] Commands, privacy documentation, and receipts reflect user-visible changes.
- [ ] Model judgments remain separate from human-accepted facts and review decisions.
